title: Vaginal Lubrication (Wetness)
summary: Vaginal lubrication is fluid that increases with arousal to reduce friction. The amount varies with hormones, hydration, cycle stage, medication and how relaxed someone feels.
key_points: Dryness is common and not a sign of lack of attraction.
Extra lube is a simple, normal solution.
Wetness alone doesn't mean someone wants sex.
